title: John: A 21-Day Devotional
description: Read one chapter of the Gospel of John each day, reflect on the theme, and spend time with God using the questions.

days.title: What if God was one of us?
days.summary: Jesus was with God at creation and stepped into ordinary human life; John 1 shows who He is through many encounters.
reflectionQuestions: What does this chapter teach you about Jesus?
Why does it matter that Jesus lived as a man?
What next step might God be asking of you?

days.title: Maybe God is waiting on you
days.summary: At the wedding in Cana, servants obey Jesus's instruction, showing He invites people to take part in His miracles.
reflectionQuestions: What does Jesus teach here?
What step of obedience is God asking of you?
Are you giving Him your best?

days.title: Are you afraid of the dark?
days.summary: Nicodemus visits Jesus at night; salvation comes through belief, and confession brings forgiveness, not condemnation.
reflectionQuestions: What do you need to confess?
How do you respond when others confess to you?

days.title: There's only one way to heal your pain
days.summary: Jesus offers the Samaritan woman living water that satisfies what the world cannot.
reflectionQuestions: What have you tried to fill your emptiness with?
What do you keep returning to?
How have you recently experienced Jesus's peace, joy, or love?

days.title: Follow Jesus, not a bunch of rules
days.summary: Leaders object to a Sabbath healing; faith is a relationship with Jesus, not a checklist.
reflectionQuestions: How has Jesus healed you?
Why do we reduce our relationship with Him to rules?

days.title: Do you have everything you need?
days.summary: Jesus feeds the 5,000, walks on water, and calls Himself the bread of life; He alone meets our needs.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
What are you afraid to surrender to Him?
Are you living a full life?

days.title: What to do when friendship hurts
days.summary: Jesus faced mockery and rejection without bitterness, so loneliness need not defeat us.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
How should you respond to a troubled relationship?
Is fear keeping you from a decision?

days.title: Who you know matters more than what you know
days.summary: Jesus's "I am" claim and the woman caught in adultery show that knowing Scripture isn't the same as knowing God.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Ask God to help you know Him, not just His words.
How can you apply a verse to your life now?

days.title: What has Jesus done for you?
days.summary: Jesus heals a man born blind; every believer has a before-and-after story worth sharing.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Who could you share your story with?
Have you given your life to Jesus?

days.title: Why working harder doesn't make you happier
days.summary: Jesus is the good shepherd and the gate; abundant life comes from Him, not from striving or possessions.
reflectionQuestions: What do you strive for compared with what Jesus pursued?
What traps keep you from the full life He offers?

days.title: Jesus, where are you?
days.summary: Jesus raises Lazarus; God can be trusted even when His timing differs from ours.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Have you doubted God's timing, and what did you learn?
Will you surrender uncertain circumstances to Him?

days.title: Would you give it all?
days.summary: Mary pours costly perfume on Jesus's feet, a model of radical trust and generosity.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
What keeps you from laying your security at His feet?
Is anything still withheld from God?

days.title: This is what forgiveness looks like
days.summary: Jesus washes the disciples' feet, including Judas and Peter; we extend the grace we've received.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Have you accepted His forgiveness?
Whom do you need to forgive?

days.title: How to show Jesus you love Him
days.summary: Jesus promises the Counselor; love for Him shows up as obedience.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Which areas of your life don't yet look like His?
What one step can you take today?

days.title: Does your life need some pruning?
days.summary: The vine and branches: stay connected to Jesus and bear fruit; pruning is a sign of growth.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Is there evidence of fruit in your life?
How can you stay connected to Him?

days.title: Who is the Holy Spirit?
days.summary: Jesus promises the Spirit who comforts, convicts, guides, and gives peace.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Is the Spirit nudging you toward a next step or a sin to address?
Do you trust that the Spirit is always with you?

days.title: Who do you pray for?
days.summary: Jesus prays for Himself, His disciples, and all future believers, and He still intercedes for us.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
How does it encourage you that He prayed for you?
How can confidence in God's love shape how you treat those who oppose you?

days.title: Where do you turn when everything goes wrong?
days.summary: Jesus is arrested and Peter denies Him, yet Jesus stays in control and trusts the Father's plan.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
How does knowing God is in control change how you see your difficulties?

days.title: Jesus did what we could not
days.summary: Jesus is crucified and declares "It is finished"; His death pays for sin.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
What overwhelming area can you bring to Him for strength?
Do you fear He is surprised by your sin?

days.title: You can start over
days.summary: The empty tomb and resurrection appearances free us from old habits for a new life.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Which old habits do you need to leave behind?
What does Jesus want you to start doing?

days.title: You can come back from that
days.summary: Jesus restores Peter by the sea; God forgives and still uses people who have failed.
reflectionQuestions: What do you learn about Jesus?
Has a sin made you feel useless to God, and will you seek help?
Is there anyone you have yet to forgive?
